=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
global grid ulong 64
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitw writes n right-aligned in w columns (w at most 20; a wider number is not cut)
fn emitw n ulong w ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 32
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
if gt w sub 20 i
i = sub 20 w
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note the walk starts at the top left going right and turns clockwise whenever the next cell is off the
note grid or already numbered; grid holds number+1 so that 0 means empty
fn spiral n ulong to void
for i ulong mul n n
put grid i 0
end
r = long 0
c = long 0
dr = long 0
dc = long 1
for k ulong mul n n
put grid add mul ulong r n ulong c add k 1
nr = add r dr
nc = add c dc
if blocked nr nc n
t = dr
dr = dc
dc = neg t
nr = add r dr
nc = add c dc
end
r = nr
c = nc
end
end
note blocked says whether (r, c) is outside the n x n grid or already numbered
fn blocked r long c long n ulong to bool
if or or lt r 0 ge r long n or lt c 0 ge c long n
ret true
end
ret ne get grid add mul ulong r n ulong c 0
end
fn show n ulong to void
for i ulong n
for j ulong n
emitw sub get grid add mul i n j 1 3
end
emit nl
end
end
fn main to int
spiral 5
show 5
emit nl
spiral 8
show 8
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
